answer: Because the counters live in the anchor ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. An operator running many aliases thus pays for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the prism quota and the wharf admission check. Submission rate is limited to 5 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole swarm from one uplink. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
